# Course Materials {.unnumbered}

Now you've installed Python and Jupyter Lab, you're ready to download and open the course materials:


# Step 1: Obtain course materials

1. Download the zip file with all [course materials](https://github.com/umcu-isi/programming-for-medical-imaging/raw/main/course_materials.zip)
2. Create a directory called `course-materials` in your `pmi` directory.
3. Unzip the zip file in this new directory.

In your `course-materials` you will see a folder called `data` and several `.ipynb` files.


## Step 2: Start Jupyter Lab and complete `preparation.ipynb`

Open a terminal, change directory to your `pmi` directory, start Jupyter Lab, and open the notebook `preparation.ipynb` from `course-materials`.
